programs.title: Matching Hearts
programs.desc: (2020) Romance starring Taylor Cole. A professional matchmaker is tasked with matchmaking a perpetually single man to boost her company's profile. Could the perfect match be right in front of them?

programs.title: Love On Repeat
programs.desc: When Amber starts re-living the same day over and over again, she realizes she is stuck in limbo and must finally decide what it will take to make her truly happy. Starring Jen Lilley (2019)

programs.title: The Blessing Bracelet
programs.desc: (2023) Uplifting drama starring Amanda Schull and Carlo Marks. When a struggling single mother rediscovers a bracelet she made as a teenager, will she find that a little belief goes a long way?

programs.title: Fishing for Love
programs.desc: (2021) Romance starring Andrea Brooks and Spencer Lord. When restaurant designer Kendall returns home to Mystic Bay and runs into an alluring new arrival, will he prove to be the perfect catch?

programs.title: Never Too Late To Celebrate
programs.desc: (2023) Romance with Alexa and Carlos PenaVega. Camila has no plans to celebrate her 30th. But when her Spanish tutor suggests a 'double quinceañera' to honour her Hispanic heritage, will sparks fly?

programs.title: A Town Called Love
programs.desc: (2022) Romance starring Emma Johnson and Marshall Williams. A famous travel writer sends Emma on a mission to debunk small-town myths. But as she scouts out one town, will she find love - in Love?

programs.title: A Royal Recipe for Love
programs.desc: (2023) Flavourful romance starring Laura Miyata and David Lafontaine. An NYC baker would love to land a cookbook deal. Will a dash of royalty and a spoonful of romance help fulfil her dream?

programs.title: 14 Love Letters
programs.desc: (2022) Romance with Vanessa Sears. When mysterious love letters appear in her mailbox, a woman embarks on a heartfelt quest -finding love where she least expects it.

programs.title: Little Women
programs.desc: This is an adaption of the much-loved coming over age title of four sisters trying to build their own identity whilst navigating life, gets a modern-day retailing. (2018)

programs.title: When Love Came to Town
programs.desc: Abby is a famous author whose latest stop on her book tour takes her to the town of Bliss. But little does she know that the locals are keen to play matchmaker for her. Lauren Holly stars. (2014)

programs.title: Cupids on Beacon Street
programs.desc: (2021) Romance with Britt Irvin. Opposites attract as an unromantic copy editor house sits with a handsome self-help coach running romantically themed workshops.

programs.title: A Wish Come True
programs.desc: (2015) Rom-com with Megan Park. On her 30th birthday, Lindsay is granted all her past wishes. When things go awry, she realises that happiness and Mr. Right were there along.
